Episode 253: Gathering Once Again inLaprarosa (4)
If there is a scene of slaughtering a god, this would be it.
The battle had started, and about 30 minutes had passed. In that time, Beltian hadn’t even managed to launch a proper counterattack, let alone gain the upper hand.
The eyeball was now only maintaining its spherical shape. The thousands of arms that had been attached to it had all been torn off and had disappeared somewhere.

Only the sun energy that intermittently exploded in the sky and on the ground showed that Beltian was still fighting. However, those explosions never managed to damage the Genesis Knights or the coalition.
'These wicked bastards... Though Beltian is an ego of Destruction, he is your mother and your father. The same goes for me. This is why this world must be made anew!'
While Bliget swallowed his tears of rage, Ameris saw right through his heart.
"Hey, Bliget. In the end, this is all your choice. The choice you made when you were whole."
[I never wanted something like this...]
“No, it is your choice. So don't even dream of things like reconstruction. Just forget it.”
[From the moment we split from the original form, Kinzelo, I was made to pursue only that. You should know this better than anyone, Great Serpent.]

"I don’t know much since I’ve forgotten a lot of memories. But there’s one thing I know. You, and Beltian, who is being ruthlessly trampled by the kids over there. Both of you are much weaker than when you were whole."
[So, do you want to laugh at us?]

“No. Mortals, you see, when they are sometimes swept up by impulse, they are completely unable to think rationally. You all were, so to speak, like mortals swept up by impulse. You can't think of anything else besides that one desire. But just as your authority has weakened, has that impulse not also weakened?”
[Great serpent, what are you trying to say?]

“I mean for you to think carefully. Whether you, the egos of the Sun God, must continue to live only within that impulse even in this weakened state. If you and Beltian were to seriously help us, the world could become a much better place.”
Bliget didn’t answer and watched the battle beyond the glass of the bridge for a while.
As he looked at the chaotic sky where lightning, blue flames, aura, and sun energy were all mixed together, a memory of the beginning suddenly came to mind.
What did Kinzelo want when he created this world?
Such questions surged up. As Ameris had said, his nature had faded as his power had weakened.
Memories felt hazy, and an unfamiliar emotion seemed to prick uncomfortably in his chest.
"Well, the choice is yours, Bliget. I’m just... saddened to see you, who were once my only light, fall like this. Let’s just watch the fight now."
Screech—!
Right after Ameris finished speaking, for the first time, Vahn's single sword strike was seen to completely split Beltian's eyeball.
Beltian tried to regenerate, but was forced back by the Eternal Flame flowing into the cut. The eyeball, now in two pieces, slowly fell to the ground like a sinking ship.
[You... dare...]
Now, there was no dignity left in that voice.

The Genesis Knights continued their violence with expressionless faces, and the fleet indifferently unleashed its main cannons. The two pieces of the eyeball that had fallen to the ground just looked like glowing meat.
What Beltian could do now was only one thing—self-destruct.
However, Beltian was certain. Even if he were to self-destruct, it was impossible to inflict any significant damage on the mortals currently attacking him.
[Malu...gia... where... are you.]

It was a moment where he desperately needed another ego that could amplify the authority of Destruction that would remain after he self-destructed. Especially if it was Malugia, he could have wiped out half of this world in an instant. Perhaps even more.
Thus, Beltian endlessly cried out Malugia's name. His time was short, so for Malugia or another ego to arrive in time would be, in the words of mortals, a miracle.
“Brother Jin, it looks like that thing is about to explode.”
“It looks that way to me too, Vahn.”
“It would be best to send the brothers down so we can protect only the core facilities needed when we fortify the Battle God Temple later. It seems this one will be difficult to use beneficially.”
Vahn had also heard about the 'power source' from Jin. So, even while enraged that Lafrarosa was being destroyed, she had wondered if there was a way to use Beltian.

However, even for the Genesis Knights, it was impossible to stop Beltian from self-destructing. To restrain him like Bligiet, he would have had to possess a mortal body like him, or maintain a restrainable form in some way.
Naturally, if he were to self-destruct, it would be meaningless.
“According to the information Orgal provided, it would be difficult for Beltian to completely annihilated.”
"I’ll be cautious with the power, Brother. And having fought Bliget, these guys don’t die easily. Even if he self-destructs, his life won’t disappear completely."
A pity.
With that thought, Jin began to prepare to withstand Beltian's self-destruction.
[Malugia... hurry, to me!]
At that moment.
Within the convection-like flow of the Genesis Knights' and Beltian's energies, a single dark and murky dimensional gate opened.
'They've come, the Ganestos.'
It was a Ganesto dimensional gate.
However, Lokia and the Ganesto knights did not emerge from the gate. What came out was a chunk of sun energy.
[...Araxion!?]
That sun energy was absorbed by Beltian at a speed that gave the Genesis Knights no time to react, and Beltian was seen instantly regaining his strength.
[Araxion! Show yourself, where are you? Let's wipe out these mortals together and go meet Malugia!]
Of course, Araxion did not respond.
Lokia had simply sent a portion of the power of Araxion, which was dwelling in Hailyn Runcandel, to the battlefield to rule out the case of Beltian being 'annihilated.'
And that partially aligned with the coalition's objective as well, since Beltian being annihilated was a burdensome matter for them too.
Amid the rapidly unfolding situations, Jin remained calm as usual.
'Lokia was in a hurry just now. She must have judged that we might just annihilate Beltian. Right now, if even one ego of the Sun God disappears, she won't be able to negotiate with the Demon Army.'
Another dimensional portal opened. Once again, a chunk of sun energy emerged from it and was absorbed by Beltian.
“Brother Jin, his energy is growing stronger again. What will you do?”
“It seems Lokia is in a hurry. He believes we might destroy Beltian. That’s why he sent Araxion’s power. For now, we need to assess the surroundings.”
“The surroundings?”

“Lokia used a lot of her strength to meet Kelliark. But in my opinion, sending such vast energy through a dimensional gate would also consume an enormous amount of authority. Especially if the distance is far.”
Vahn nodded.
“I understand what you mean.”

“Flagship Sarah! Head Butler, look through the records of the outskirts of Lafrarosa immediately. The rest of the fleet, maintain a defensive formation and commence a search of Lafrarosa. The Ganestos are definitely here somewhere!”
Jin was certain. There was no way the Ganesto group was safely supporting Beltian from somewhere far away.
If Lokia had planned everything from the start, there would have been no reason to support Beltian in this way.
'Lokia doesn't know that we have no intention of annihilating Beltian. If I can use that to strengthen Beltian, and then change him into a restrainable form.'
Maybe they could use Beltian as an energy source for the Battle God Temple.
'The strengthening is being handled by Lokia anyway, so that's not a problem. But changing him into a restrainable form... I have no idea how. Do I have to talk to Bligiet again?'
Bliget, thanks to his conversation with Lucy, had already shared all the information he knew.
Ameris, the one who knew the most ancient secrets, also had not contacted him, so it seemed there was no suitable method.
In the midst of these thoughts, Jin’s communicator vibrated.
{[Jin Runcandel.]}
“Bliget?”
{[You must want to restrain Beltian just like me. I have thought of a way. Send me down.]}

{Jin, from what I hear, it doesn't seem like a trick. It's only been a short time since the battle started, but Bluggiet has changed a bit. Thanks to his conversation with me. Shall we send him down?}
“Understood, Lady Ameris. I will be on standby below the flagship.”
Beltian's eyeball, split into two pieces, was now swelling up after consuming Araxion's power. As if the single eyeball from before it was bisected had now doubled.
It meant Beltian's authority had grown that much stronger. Now, even the Genesis Knights could not easily overwhelm Beltian as they had until now.
[GRRRRAAAHHHH!]
Every time Beltian let out a roar, the entirety of Lafrarosa shook from the shockwave, and cracks appeared on the Golden Fleet's linked shields.

Jin, under the cover of Vahn and Murakan, took a position below the flagship Sarah. Then, the bottom of the ship opened and Bluggiet descended, and Jin safely caught him so that he would not be swept away by the storm of all kinds of energy.
[Jin Runcandel, I have realized. I will bet my everything on you all.]
“Suddenly?”
[It’s because I’ve remembered great emotions and memories I had forgotten as a creator. Anyway, now is a very urgent moment. Take me to Beltian, so he can see this.]
Bluggiet spread his hands as if offering something precious. Above them was a lump of rainbow-colored energy.
“This... This is sun energy? It’s sun energy, but it’s a completely different color.”

[This is not a simple energy, but can be called a memory of the beginning, from when I was whole. If I show this to Beltian, he will obediently follow my words. Because he too must have completely forgotten this memory.]
